note: Triennial election of the rural district council on the 29 district electoral divisions made by the Ministry of Home Affairs order of 12 June 1923 (Belfast Gazette, 22 June 1923); nominations received by W. R. Bell, J.P., returning officer, 30 April 1924, and no withdrawals by 7 May. Nationalists took no part (Frontier Sentinel, 10 May 1924, p. 5), and 17 divisions had no nomination: Belleek, Camlough, Camly, Creggan, Crossmaglen, Culloville, Dorsy, Drumintee, Fathom, Forkhill, Glassdrumman, Killeen, Killeavy, Lathbirget, Moybane, Mullaghbane and Poyntzpass. Returned unopposed.
